environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on AKS cluster running the container as a privileged pod with hostPath volume mount to /etc/secrets on the node filesystem. The pod runs with securityContext.privileged=true and mounts the host's /opt/app-secrets as /etc/secrets. No network policy restricts ingress to the /api/token/validate endpoint. The container image runs as root (UID 0). The cluster has no PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurity admission controller enabled.
